Rune reasoning: Amumu — Curse of the Sad Mummy: Use adaptive stats for the actual damage helper and a finisher matching the starting enemy/owner HP. The keystone proc is measured separately; damage type alone does not justify attack speed, crit, or an ultimate modifier. Ability basis: R3 is400+0.8 AP magic; pre-applied Curse adds10% true damage from magic damage taken. MR penetration improves magic and its associated Curse amount. Deathcap amplifies AP; Shadowflame supplies15 flat magic penetration/conditional lowHP magic-true amplification Arcane Comet: Comet is separate damage and can miss; target movement and range affect the comparison. Axiom Arcanist: Eligibility-tested ultimate modifier; classification and true/pet/on-hit/revive exceptions are not inferred from slot alone. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Bloodline: Exactly15 earned stacks give85HP; equipped Riftmaker converts actual bonus HP into AP for this helper. No additional lifesteal damage or free stacks. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Axiom targets eligible native ultimate output. Check single-target versus area classification, and pet/on-hit/transform/true-damage exceptions. Its takedown refund is not extra damage inside one fixed cast. Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Bloodline: exactly15 earned legend stacks for85HP; read the actual Riftmaker HP-to-AP result before the scored event.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

builds.hypothesis: The tooltip gives 10 flat magic damage plus (1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 + 0.005 AP)% enemy maximum HP per second. Rank 5 over four seconds nominally totals 40 plus (8 + 0.02 AP)% target maximum HP, before tick boundaries and mitigation. AP increases a target-health coefficient as well as item effects; this is not 0.5% per AP.
